title: 4 Habits Every Teen Should Learn Before 18 | Twins Realty
description:
Good financial habits don’t start in adulthood — they start much earlier.

In this episode, we talk about four important habits teens can learn before turning 18 that can make a huge difference in their financial future.

From understanding credit to learning how to live below your means, these lessons can help young people build a stronger foundation before stepping into adulthood.

If you're raising teens or preparing them for real-world financial decisions, this conversation highlights practical advice that can benefit families across Killeen, Temple, Belton, and surrounding Central Texas areas.

In this episode:
• Why understanding credit early matters
• The importance of living below your means
• How financial decisions create long-term consequences
• Why building good habits early can shape future opportunities

Financial responsibility is a life skill — and the earlier it's learned, the better prepared the next generation will be.

📍 Serving buyers and sellers across Central Texas.
